method.what: SSO string sections' All techniques Long (UACC CC32 = 1) against CC1 over the Long's sounding range (sso_sound_range.json: the map gives none): Violins 1 / 2 and Violas every 3 semitones; Celli (36-81) and Basses (24-54) at every semitone
method.measured: 2026-10-11 on the Windows 11 test VM, the real Spitfire Symphony Orchestra in Kontakt Player 8.13.1 (VST 3), offline, by the VM's test host kthost (one instance per section, 44.1 kHz stereo float, 512-frame blocks split at each event as MuseScore does); Celli and Basses again at every semitone on 2026-10-14, the same way (one kthost process per 8 pitches, each with a fresh warm-up note outside its pitches): the 2026-10-11 points they share come out identical
method.setups: the setups MuseScore made from each patch's .nki (maker 2, $iooxo=3) and Kontakt resaved, unedited (MuseScore's setups folder on the VM, copied); the library's defaults: Mic Mix Distance 0.5, Mic 1-5 level 1, Vibrato 1, Release 0.496, Tightness 0.504 (sso_sound_controls.json)
method.events: CC32 1 and CC11 127 once; a warm-up note (not measured); then per pitch, per CC1 value, 4 notes in a row (two round robins alternate: each plays twice), held 3.0 s, 1.5 s apart, velocity = CC1 (MuseScore sends a Long with velocity and CC1 both expressionLevel of the dynamic: Whence at mf, CC1 64, velocity 64), CC1 sent 1 s before its note-on

measures.rmsDb: mean power of both channels 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, dB full scale
measures.lufs: ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated loudness (pyloudnorm 0.2.0) of the note-on to the note-off, LUFS
measures.sones: ISO 532-1 stationary loudness (mosqito 1.2.1 loudness_zwst, free field, resampled to 48 kHz) of the mid channel 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, samples as pascals: only ratios mean anything
measures.loudDb: the dynamics check's measure: the loudest 50 ms (25 ms hop) of the note and 0.5 s of its release
measures.loud1sDb: the same over the note's first 1.0 s and 0.5 s more (the dynamics check's 1 s note: comparable with sso_sound_dynamics.json and the rest check's pp)

method.points: per pitch, per CC1: the median of the 4 repeats and their spread (max - min); Celli and Basses also rmsDbTakes, each take in the order played (even: one round robin, odd: the other). Offline, a round robin's takes are identical (0.000 dB apart at every point), so the 4 repeats' median is exactly the mean of the two round robins
method.relative64: per measure: [cc, median over pitches of (value - value at CC1 64; sones: ratio), min, max, pitches, median repeat spread, largest repeat spread]
